title: Docker Commands for Testers Companion
title_es: Companion de Comandos Docker para Testers
description: Runnable files from the Docker cheat sheet for testers: a docker-compose test stack with healthchecks, a multi-stage Dockerfile.test, and cleanup/spin-up shell scripts.
description_es: Archivos ejecutables del cheat sheet de Docker para testers: un stack docker-compose con healthchecks, un Dockerfile.test multi-stage y scripts de limpieza y levantado.
